identity.description: Waterfall.io is a B2B data/GTM API that aggregates 30+ data vendors for contact, email and phone enrichment, prospecting, job-change tracking and email verification.
identity.identity_notes: Docs and site clearly describe Waterfall.io contact/company intel API.

auth.scopes_notes: Master key required to create/manage sub-keys; 403 can also indicate a feature/permission unavailable to the key (e.g., Preview APIs require access on key).

access.production_restrictions: Key management requires contacting account manager; higher rate limits via support email.

api.rate_limits: Default 50 requests per 60 seconds for Prospector, Search, Enrichment, Job Change, Email Verification; higher on request.
api.limitations: Search Company and Company Titles are Preview APIs; Company Titles requires access on key. Many endpoints are async (job_id then Finder or webhook).

claims.quote: Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the x-api-key header. Contact the team for API access and pricing.
You need a Waterfall API key with Contact Enrichment enabled. Contact the team for access and pricing.
The Waterfall API is available at https://api.waterfall.io . Send your API key in the x-api-key header.
Explore Waterfall’s APIs and compare their inputs, results, and use cases to choose the right endpoint for your workflow.
The default limit for Prospector, Search, Enrichment, Job Change, and Email Verification is 50 requests per 60 seconds .
Webhook signing applies to every endpoint that accepts webhook_url .

open_questions: Is there an official MCP server? Sources do not mention one.
Is there a free trial or sandbox? Sources only say to contact the team for access and pricing.

rationale: Credentials require partnership, vendor approval or sales.
